<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="opHDpSchoMQxZ-GY5mi4"> <mxGraphModel dx="2586" dy="909" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml

title BrewLite - Sequence Diagram: Dat hang va thanh toan VNPay

autonumber
skinparam monochrome true
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12

actor \"Customer\" as C
participant \"Next.js UI\" as UI
participant \"NestJS API\" as API
database \"Database\" as DB
participant \"Payment Service\" as VNP

== GIAI DOAN 1: GUI YEU CAU DAT HANG ==

C -> UI: Nhan nut \"Tien hanh thanh toan\"
activate UI

UI -> UI: handleCreateOrder()
UI -> UI: toCreateOrderPayload(items)

UI -> API: createOrder(payload, userId, idempotencyKey)\nPOST /orders
activate API

API -> API: ValidationPipe (validate CreateOrderDto)
API -> API: OrdersController.create()
API -> API: OrdersController.getUserId() -> jwtService.verify(token)
API -> API: OrdersService.create(userId, dto, idempotencyKey)

API -> DB: prisma.payment.findUnique(idempotencyKey)
activate DB
DB --> API: existingPayment / null
deactivate DB

alt [idempotencyKey da duoc xu ly]

 API -> API: assertOrderIdempotencyOwner()
 API --> UI: serializeOrder(existingPayment.order) [201 Created]

else [Request moi]

 == GIAI DOAN 2: KIEM TRA GIA, TON KHO VA TAO DON ==

 API -> DB: Promise.all([user.findFirst, product.findMany,\nproductSize.findMany, productTopping.findMany, productRecipe.findMany])
 activate DB
 DB --> API: User, Product, Price, Size, Topping, Recipe
 deactivate DB

 API -> API: Tinh gia Server-side (unitPrice, lineTotal, subtotal)\n& Tong hop nhu cau nguyen lieu (ingredientDemandMap)

 alt [User/San pham hop le va du ton kho]

 group prisma.$transaction() - executeOrderCreation(tx)

 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
 activate DB

 API -> DB: tx.ingredient.updateMany()\nwhere(id, version, stockQuantity >= reqQty)
 API -> DB: tx.product.updateMany()
 API -> DB: tx.topping.updateMany()

 alt [Optimistic Lock thanh cong (count > 0)]

 API -> DB: tx.order.create(status: PENDING,\norderItems: { create }, statusHistory: { create })
 API -> DB: tx.payment.create(BREWLITE, PENDING)
 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Created Order

 else [Version conflict / count == 0]

 API -> DB: ROLLBACK
 DB --> API: ConflictException

 end

 deactivate DB

 end

 alt [Transaction COMMIT]

 API -> API: serializeOrder(order)
 API --> UI: 201 Created (CreatedOrderResponse)

 else [Transaction ROLLBACK]

 API --> UI: 409 Conflict

 end

 else [User/San pham khong hop le / Khong du ton kho]

 API --> UI: 400 Bad Request

 end

end

deactivate API

alt [Create Order Success]

 UI -> UI: clearCart()
 UI -> UI: router.push(\"/checkout?orderId=...\")
 UI --> C: Hien thi trang /checkout

else [Create Order Failed]

 UI -> UI: setErrorMessage(msg)
 UI --> C: Hien thi thong bao loi

end

deactivate UI

== GIAI DOAN 3: KHOI TAO THANH TOAN VNPAY ==

C -> UI: Nhan nut \"Thanh toan qua VNPay\"
activate UI

UI -> UI: submitVnpayPayment()

UI -> API: createVnpayPayment(orderId, idempotencyKey)\nPOST /payments/orders/:id/vnpay
activate API

API -> API: JwtAuthGuard.canActivate()
API -> API: JwtStrategy.validate(payload)

API -> DB: prisma.user.findUnique(payload.sub)
activate DB
DB --> API: User
deactivate DB

API -> API: PaymentsController.createVnpayPayment()
API -> API: PaymentsService.createVnpayPayment()
API -> API: PaymentsService.getVnpayConfig()

API -> DB: prisma.$transaction() - SELECT FOR UPDATE\n& tx.order.findUnique(orderId)
activate DB

opt [Chua co expiresAt]
 API -> DB: tx.order.update(expiresAt)
end

API -> DB: tx.payment.findUnique(idempotencyKey)\n& tx.payment.findFirst(VNPAY, PENDING)

alt [Chua co Payment Attempt PENDING]

 API -> DB: tx.payment.create(VNPAY, PENDING)
 DB --> API: New Payment Record

else [Payment Attempt PENDING da ton tai]

 DB --> API: Existing Payment Record

end

deactivate DB

API -> API: vietnamTimestamp()
API -> API: orderedQuery()
API -> API: createHmac(\"sha512\", hashSecret)

API --> UI: 200 OK (paymentUrl, orderId, paymentStatus)
deactivate API

UI -> UI: window.location.assign(paymentUrl)
UI --> C: Chuyen huong trinh duyet sang VNPay
deactivate UI

C -> VNP: Nhap the test NCB & xac nhan OTP
activate VNP

== GIAI DOAN 4: XU LY IPN VNPAY ==

VNP -> API: GET /payments/vnpay/ipn
activate API

API -> API: PaymentsController.handleVnpayIpn()
API -> API: PaymentsService.handleIpn()
API -> API: normalizedQuery() & verifySignature(params, hashSecret)

alt [Invalid Signature / Merchant / Data]

 API --> VNP: RspCode 97 / 99

else [Valid Signature]

 API -> DB: prisma.payment.findUnique(vnp_TxnRef)
 activate DB
 DB --> API: Payment Record
 deactivate DB

 alt [Invalid Order / Amount]

 API --> VNP: RspCode 01 / 04

 else [IPN da xu ly truoc do]

 API --> VNP: RspCode 00 (neu SUCCESS trung TransactionNo) / RspCode 02

 else [Payment Success (00/00) va Order con han]

 group prisma.$transaction() - Payment Success

 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION & SELECT FOR UPDATE
 activate DB

 API -> DB: tx.payment.update(SUCCESS)
 API -> DB: tx.order.update(PAID, pointsEarned=100)
 API -> DB: tx.orderStatusHistory.create(PAID)
 API -> DB: tx.user.update(loyaltyPoints + 100)

 opt [Co ma khuyen mai]

 API -> DB: tx.promotion.update(usedCount + 1)
 API -> DB: tx.promotionUsage.upsert()

 end

 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Payment Updated
 deactivate DB

 end

 API --> VNP: RspCode 00 (Confirm Success)

 else [Payment Failed / Cancelled va Order con han]

 group prisma.$transaction() - Payment Failed

 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION & SELECT FOR UPDATE
 activate DB

 API -> DB: tx.payment.update(FAILED / CANCELLED)
 API -> DB: tx.order.update(PAYMENT_FAILED)
 API -> DB: tx.orderStatusHistory.create(PAYMENT_FAILED)

 note right of DB
 Chua hoan ton kho.
 Cho phep thu lai thanh toan.
 end note

 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Payment Updated
 deactivate DB

 end

 API --> VNP: RspCode 00 (Confirm Success)

 else [Order het han TTL]

 group prisma.$transaction() - Expire Order

 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION & SELECT FOR UPDATE
 activate DB

 API -> DB: tx.order.update(CANCELLED)
 API -> DB: tx.orderStatusHistory.create(CANCELLED)
 API -> API: restoreOrderStock(tx, orderId)
 API -> DB: tx.payment.update(status)
 API -> DB: COMMIT

 DB --> API: Order Expired
 deactivate DB

 end

 API --> VNP: RspCode 00 (Confirm Success)

 end

end

deactivate API
deactivate VNP

== GIAI DOAN 5: RETURN URL VA XAC NHAN KET QUA ==

note over C,VNP
 IPN va Return URL la hai luong doc lap.
 Return URL co the den truoc IPN.
end note

VNP -> API: Dieu huong trinh duyet ve GET /payments/vnpay/return
activate API

API -> API: PaymentsController.handleVnpayReturn()
API -> API: PaymentsService.getReturnDestination(query)

API -> DB: prisma.payment.findUnique(vnp_TxnRef)
activate DB
DB --> API: Payment Record / orderId
deactivate DB

API --> C: HTTP 302 Redirect\n/checkout/confirmation?orderId=...&paymentReturn=vnpay
deactivate API

C -> UI: Mo trang /checkout/confirmation (OrderConfirmationContent)
activate UI

loop [Polling moi 4s khi orderStatus == PENDING]

 UI -> API: getOrderById(orderId)\nGET /orders/:id
 activate API

 API -> API: OrdersController.findById()
 API -> API: OrdersService.findById()

 API -> DB: prisma.order.findUnique(orderId)
 activate DB
 DB --> API: Order Details
 deactivate DB

 API --> UI: 200 OK (CreatedOrderResponse)
 deactivate API

 UI -> UI: setOrder(updated)

end

alt [Order Status = PAID]

 UI --> C: Hien thi \"Thanh toan thanh cong\"

else [Order Status = PAYMENT_FAILED]

 UI --> C: Hien thi \"Thanh toan khong thanh cong\" & link xem don (/orders/:id)

else [Order Status = CANCELLED]

 UI --> C: Hien thi \"Don hang da huy\"

else [Order Status = PENDING]

 UI --> C: Hien thi \"Dang xac nhan thanh toan\"

end

deactivate UI
